STANDALONE MACHINES (cairn/machines/) — each needs a home or a reason to stay
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)
artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). USERS: everyone who writes a record.
charter: compiles a component's bounded state from its history. Held by CodeMother.

The inspectors are not assumed correct; they are examined when they refuse. A failure is not automatically "it broke, change it". After a gate refuses, an LLM sets the refusing sieve's intention and why beside the ticket's intention and why and asks: is this sieve the best we can do right now? If yes, the ticket changes. If no, the sieve is fixed. Either way the system improves, constantly. WHY: questions about a part are answered by its intention and why against the new thing's intention and why, so a disagreement becomes an update to an intention or to its implementation plan, never a conversation about procedure (Akien, 2026-11-02). The sieves stay deterministic and never weigh a why; the LLM check comes only after a failure. It is never a lock pick because it has no third outcome: the ticket changes, or the sieve is fixed through its own ticket and proof. Nothing passes a ticket over a red; testing a sieve is what the ticket that fixes it does. (Q#62, Akien 2026-11-02.)
